goals: Daily remaining-horizon arrival probabilities from fixed purchase price at +10% and +15%
entry: Next official trading-session open after the original eight-model signal; purchase day is session 1
landmark: After each session close 1..19; session 0 at purchase open is an initial-only reference; deadline always original session20
arrival_secondary: Future close touches the same fixed purchase-price target
already_arrived: Absorbing arrived status, probability1; excluded from future-arrival scoring to avoid trivial accuracy
base_models: Current eight November4 financial-input C models, exact E123 OOF hashes, unchanged
source: E123 signal_paths and OHLC paths, prices through November5; technical and volume inputs only at or before each landmark
quality: Select daily top2 by base-three frozen percentile>=95 before excluding incomplete paths/ranking universes; learn on the broad complete eight-model reference cohort; no replacement of excluded signals
ml_entry_features: Raw six classifier scores, two full-pool entry-day rank percentiles, known entry gap and entry-day technical state; no retrospective future-score percentile transform in model inputs

arms.daily_state: Exactly static_age plus price/volume/ATR/market path through current close

inner_training: Expanding history with entire trade20-session maturity strictly before validation start; never split one trade across train and validation
calibration: Monotone Platt sigmoid on held-out broad-cohort predictions from an April1 fitted model; parameters frozen before outer evaluation; pairwise monotone projection p15<=p10
outer_refits: Monthly expanding, entire trade maturity strictly before month start; first cutoff October8 2025 after base-HPO label maturity; hyperparameters, calibration and exit thresholds frozen
score_primary: Brier loss over unarrived close-landmarks; compare both tuned arms on identical trade-landmarks; report trade-equal and day-bucket diagnostics separately
training_weights: Uniform at-risk landmark observations. Each trade has the same20 planned slots; do not inverse-weight realized risk duration because it depends on future event time. No class balancing that would alter probability priors
auxiliary_tuning: Same six candidates and three inner windows; expected continuation gain regression for both arms/targets, dynamic-only competing classifier and .25/.5/.75 quantile models
continuation_label: Fixed target/20-session-deadline sale return minus next-open sale return, both relative to original entry; opening profit gaps capped at the target in primary comparison
exit_policy: After current close, sell next open if predicted continuation gain below frozen cutoff; existing target order remains effective; otherwise keep until target or original deadline
exit_selection: Chosen per arm/target on selected-model inner-CV strict-cohort trades, at least30 trades/10 signal dates; mean net return minus standard error of signal-date means; otherwise cutoff0 declared fallback

stop_secondary.same_bar: Stop first unless observed opening price establishes target first; stop gaps at observed open

uncertainty: Paired21-market-session moving signal-date blocks of landmark losses or trade returns, 2000 draws, seed123; keep every trade's rows together; daily rows are not independent trades
known_limitations: Historical outer period was already viewed during prior feature and exit research; this is exploratory, not fresh future confirmation
Base-model hyperparameters used pre-September2025 labels; that history is fitting/tuning only, not untouched outer evidence
E123 reconstructed mart keys, not full latest feature-value parity; ranking-dependent evidence is conditional on complete historical pools
Daily OHLC cannot establish intraday order or actual liquidity; no taxes or dividends
Broad-cohort training may be less calibrated in the sparse high-score tail; report tail metrics separately
Only six finite hyperparameter candidates, not a claim of global optimization
